name: Panel From Outline and Thickness
description: Creates a Panel from a Polyline and Thickness.

inputParameters.name: outline
inputParameters.description: Referenced polyline, Guid of polyline in the active Rhino document.

inputParameters.name: orientation
inputParameters.description: (Optional) Direction of the panel's local y-axis, e.g. up for a wall. Unset: derived from the outline.

inputParameters.name: features
inputParameters.description: (Optional) Panel feature definitions, including openings, from the Panel Opening, MEP Penetration, Niche or Linear Service components. Definitions that do not lie on this panel are skipped, so the same list can go to every panel.

inputParameters.name: identify_doors
inputParameters.description: If True, door-shaped notches in the panel outline are cut out of the outline and added as door Openings. Other openings come in through 'features'.

inputParameters.name: updateRefObj
inputParameters.description: (optional) If True, the attributes in the referenced object will be updated/overwritten with the new values given here.
